items.bullet_summary_preload:
- The **producer price index** rose 1.3% in September and 6.3% annually, the largest monthly jump since 2022, **Bureau of Labor Statistics** data showed[2][4].
- Retail sales rose 0.8% on higher gasoline receipts, **Commerce Department** data showed, a day after CPI showed 3.7% annual inflation[6][7].
- The data raise stakes for the **Federal Reserve**, which hiked in September for the first time in over three years and meets Oct. 27-28[7].

The department has charged about 90 people with election misconduct this year, including 50 accused of voting as noncitizens....
items.bullet_summary_preload:
- The **Justice Department** sued California Secretary of State **Shirley Weber** on Thursday, seeking to block the counting of mail ballots from alleged noncitizens, CNBC reported[2].
- The lawsuit came after a 48-hour deadline expired; acting Deputy Attorney General **R. Trent McCotter** had asked officials to set aside flagged voters' ballots[4][5].
- Weber called the effort unlawful and said it fuels chaos, while a UCLA voting rights group planned to seek a restraining order Thursday, The Hill reported[6].
